spec.description: Overview dashboard for the Azure Managed Grafana team bug bash session using Grafana 13 Git Sync.

options.content:
# Azure Managed Grafana – Git Sync Bug Bash

Welcome to the bug bash for Grafana 13 Git Sync! This dashboard is managed via Git Sync and lives in a GitHub repository.

## What to Test

- **Bi-directional sync**: Edit a dashboard in Grafana and verify the changes appear as a pull request in GitHub.
- **Pull request previews**: Merge a PR and verify the dashboard is updated automatically.
- **Edit from GitHub**: Modify a dashboard JSON file directly in GitHub and verify the change appears in Grafana.
- **Folder sync**: Create/rename/delete folders and verify structure is reflected in GitHub.
- **Conflict resolution**: Make simultaneous edits in Grafana and GitHub and observe how conflicts are handled.

## Repo Structure

```
grafana/
  bug-bash-overview.json          ← this dashboard (root level)
  AzureManagedGrafana/
    team-dashboard.json           ← team-specific dashboard
    metrics-overview.json         ← metrics overview
```

## Useful Links

- [Git Sync Documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/observability-as-code/provision-resources/git-sync-setup/)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Jeralan/gitsynctest)

**Edit this dashboard from the Grafana UI or directly in GitHub to test Git Sync!**

Save changes in Grafana → push to a branch → open a PR → merge → see the update reflected.
